verdict.rationale: Granola ships a documented public REST API: a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec with /v1 endpoints for notes, transcripts, folders, spaces, audit, webhook-endpoints and legal holds. It also has a live 'Try it' API playground, scoped API keys, published rate limits and a versioned changelog. Together these cover the story's core of programmatically driving the product through a documented API. missing for 10: API access is limited to Business/Enterprise plans, there is no sandbox or test environment, no deprecation or back-compat policy is published, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
